payload.text: Final implementation: a deterministic worker-authored ECS scene rendered by Aperture native WebGPU with the standard extraction snapshot boundary and manual frame control. Features include ivory stucco walls with real front and side apertures, dark mullioned inset windows, paneled door and lantern, two-post tiled porch, individual barrel roof tiles, gutter/downpipes, capped chimney, paved entry and side path, low coursed stone boundary with pillars and mailbox, planters, shrubs, modeled olive/cypress trees, grass and lavender, curved asphalt road with segmented curbs and broken white center markings, and a blue contoured hatchback with crowned roof, tinted glass, mirrors, lamps, grille, badge, trim, seams, wheel arches and four tire/alloy wheel assemblies. All visible geometry is published as 65 material batches in ordinary simulation ECS; authored builder counts are 1,246,194 vertices and 415,398 triangles, not timing or native-counter estimates. inspectGeometry derives owned positions, normals, triangle ranges and complete instance matrices from the public submitted-geometry receipt API. Previews 2 and 3 passed native rendering and geometry preflight in the canonical and two orbit views; preview 1 failed at asynchronous bootstrap and was corrected. Final cosmetic adjustments after preview 3 added smaller leaves, changed car placement/ground contact and headlight/roof detail, softened grain and added a chimney crown; these final changes were build-tested and two fresh headless worker extractions completed without diagnostics, but were not browser-previewed because all three preview requests were spent. The car and vegetation remain stylized procedural approximations, and distant terrain is simple. No external scene assets, reference-image textures, custom shaders, image generation, alternate renderer or application animation loop were used. No application servers or browsers were launched by the author. All headless app checks awaited public disposal, and recorded process supervision reports no remaining descendants. Final build: /work/dist; source: /work/src/scene.js, /work/src/main.js, /work/src/worker.js, /work/src/config.js; summary: /work/scene-summary.json.
